📄 ChartSpec Contract

Validated JSON-serializable intermediate representation

{
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "bar",
  "data": [
    {
      "region": "North America",
      "sales": 1250
    },
    {
      "region": "Europe",
      "sales": 980
    },
    {
      "region": "Asia Pacific",
      "sales": 1420
    },
    {
      "region": "Latin America",
      "sales": 610
    },
    {
      "region": "Middle East",
      "sales": 430
    }
  ],
  "encoding": {
    "x": {
      "field": "region",
      "type": "categorical"
    },
    "y": {
      "field": "sales",
      "type": "quantitative"
    }
  },
  "title": "Regional Sales (AutoChart)"
}

🛡️ MVP Scope Verification

  • Deterministic ChartSpec validation (Zod schema)
  • SVG rendering with zero DOM runtime in @core
  • Screen reader fallback <table> included in SVGContainer
  • SSR compatible (Next.js server & client safe)
  • Bundle budget: core + 1 chart ≤ 15kb gzipped
